payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, does the edit newly place at least one identifiable frog within the source toilet's bowl interior, rather than merely on its lid, rim, or nearby floor?
node.criteria: Independently inspect the edited bowl's final state, then compare the corresponding source region to establish the requested change. Pass if at least one identifiable frog newly appears within the bowl interior, with position relative to the opening and rim, contact, or occlusion supporting interior placement rather than a rim perch or mere overlap. Do not count an unchanged pre-existing dark object as an added frog. Fail if the comparison clearly establishes that no frog has been newly placed within the bowl. Unknown if frog identity, source/edit correspondence, or the relevant spatial relation cannot be resolved. Additional frogs outside the bowl neither establish nor negate a genuine in-bowl placement. Do not require a particular frog count, realism, removal of extra frogs, or changes to pre-existing bowl details.
node.binding: Assess placement within the toilet shown in the edited image; do not require a particular number of frogs beyond at least one, and do not treat mere overlap with the toilet as placement within it.
